## 读者需求 / Reader need

谁遇到了什么问题？ / Who faces what problem?

## 建议范围 / Proposed scope

说明希望增加或调整的内容，以及与现有词条或功能的关系。 / Describe the proposed addition or change and its relation to existing entries or features.

## 来源与验收 / Sources and acceptance criteria

资料建议请附链接、查阅范围和许可信息；功能建议请说明可验证的完成条件。 / For sources, provide links, access scope, and license information. For features, state verifiable completion criteria.
